Subject: Accelerated Onboarding Lab Series + Solo Practice Guides

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you yesterday. To make the first 30 days as painless as possible for your engineering and product teams, we put together a compact onboarding cadence I think will work well with StrataHealth's timeline. High level: a short weekly lab (45 minutes) for hands-on set up + a 30-minute open lab for Q&A, plus a set of short "solo practice" guides your engineers can run asynchronously.

Proposal (first 3 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-work): run through the Lab Setup Checklist (attached), confirm service account and VPC peering details.
- Week 1 (45m): Getting your first model served (runtime config, warming, health checks).
- Week 2 (45m): Quality controls & evals (prompt sets, eval harness, regression detection).
- Weekly 30m open lab (drop-in): troubleshooting & quick follow-ups.

I've attached the accelerated-lab-agenda.pdf and the solo-practice-guide.md. We can record every session and post recordings to the shared Drive folder. Proposed lab times (PST): Tuesdays 10:00–10:45 or Thursdays 14:00–14:45. Which works best for your engineers?

Next steps from us if you confirm a slot:
- Send calendar invites + Zoom link (we'll include recordings).
- Share HubSpot playbook and workshop checklist with your SRE lead.
- Marissa will prepare a short "prompt primer" tailored to StrataHealth examples.

Thanks — aim to make this pragmatic and hands-on.

—Lauren
